title: Knead'n'Snapper
description: A buttery and crisp Ukrainian dish featuring snapper fish that's perfect for post-workout enjoyment. Pescatarian-friendly.
instructions: Mix flour, salt, and pepper in a shallow dish. Dredge fish fillets in the seasoned flour.
Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic and thyme leaves; cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Place fish fillets into the skillet and cook for about 5 minutes on each side or until golden brown.
For the topping: Combine buttermilk with panko bread crumbs. Spread mixture evenly over cooked fish.
Top with honey mustard mayo and place back in the skillet. Cook for another 2-3 minutes until the toppings are crispy.
Serve hot as a main dish or side, paired with steamed kale.
